clues.text: In King Solomon's day, one could be imported from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver.
When Pharaoh's army chased Israel into the sea, the LORD made the wheels of these wobble.
On the desert road to Gaza, an Ethiopian official sat in one, reading the prophet Isaiah.
Pharaoh honored Joseph by having him ride in his second one, with men shouting, "Bow the knee!"
A watchman in Jezreel saw one approaching and said its driver drove like Jehu, like a madman.
After King Ahab died in battle, his was washed at the pool of Samaria while dogs licked up his blood.
When the LORD routed his army before Barak, Sisera left his behind and fled on foot.
